Self.Wiki: Sound dummy point (formerly Dummy; Nightreign calls the type SoundDummy). The sound system registers its position and feeds the listener's distance to it into the Wwise RTPC DistanceFromDummyPoint_0N, where N is the Dummy Point Index. Sound designers use it to fade sounds with distance from a spot, such as bridges, waterfalls, magma and wind. 28 regions in retail.

DummyPointIndex.Wiki: Which RTPC this point drives: 0-4 select DistanceFromDummyPoint_00 to _04. The game reads it as a byte and clamps it to 5. Retail uses 0-3, and the index usually matches the number in the region's name (e.g. サウンド_ダミーポイント[3] uses 3).
